topic: Sources, Production, and Loudness of Sound
key_concepts: Sounds in the environment have identifiable sources.
Sounds are not all the same and can be described.
A vibrating ruler can produce sound.
A plucked rubber band can produce sound.
When the vibration stops, the sound stops.
Loudness is a property of sound that can be investigated.
Factors such as the sound source or setup may affect loudness.
